notes: XRD (alpha-Mg/beta-Mg17Al12, no MgO/Mg2Si) and Table 1 (n, sigma_thr) are not in the packet; phase node omitted. Branches: (1) SiCp dispersion + grain refinement + interface -> YS (joint causes); (2) SiCp -> threshold stress -> lower minimum creep rate -> creep resistance for >=15 wt%, with n_t ~5.5 -> climb. Side: UCS, fracture mode, design guidance. Audits: grain size not resolvable in F1 (o5), UTS falls with SiCp (o7), AZ91 also shows a threshold stress (o16). Three explanations of sigma_thr are listed by the paper without a choice; kept in n18 attrs, not as alternative causes.
